description: Image Description: The image shows a view from inside a ski lift or gondola, looking out over a snowy mountain landscape. In the foreground, there is a ski leaning against the window. The ski is branded with the word "HEAD." There is a sticker on the window with the text "THIS IS NOT YOGHURT" and a graphic design above the text. In the background, you can see snow-covered slopes, trees, and a few buildings at the base of the mountain.
